_provenance.method: playwright crawl.mjs capture + computed-style aggregation probe
_provenance.notes: Single-page extract (--single). Palette/type/motif aggregated from home computed styles across all elements.

logo.notes: Wordmark 'INDIA UNCHARTED' with small emblem; appears in header (dark on light) and footer (light on dark).

palette.notes: warm sand panel behind 'Find Travel Perfection'
deep espresso brown, used on dark overlays + footer
coral / terracotta — the signature accent, all CTAs and highlights
muted clay/taupe — heading color for section eyebrows and H1

scaleAudit.notes: Hero headline 40px but section titles compressed; large jump then flat. Weak modular rhythm.

borderRadius.notes: mix of 20px cards, 50px pill CTAs, and small 5-6px chips — inconsistent radius ladder

decorative: faint world-map / dotted-route watermark behind sections

voice.tagline: UNLIMITED CHOICES | BEST PRICES | HAPPY MEMORIES | HOT DEALS
samples: Welcome to India Uncharted, your trusted partner for immersive and personalized journeys across India.

From the royal palaces and desert landscapes of Rajasthan to the serene backwaters of Kerala, the spiritual energy of Varanasi, and the majestic beauty of the Himalayas, we design journeys that go beyond sightseeing.
At India Uncharted, we don't just organize trips — we create stories you'll cherish for a lifetime.
voice.register: warm, aspirational, hospitality-led; personal ('your journey', 'crafted for you'); India-romantic

systemComponents.header: Logo left; nav (Home, About Us, Destinations, Activity, Transfers, Blogs, Contact Us); phone number; coral pill 'BOOKING/ENQUIRY' CTA right.
systemComponents.footer: Charcoal; logo + blurb; Get In Touch (address, phone, email); Quick Links; Location; social icons; copyright.
systemComponents.persistentCta: Coral pill CTAs throughout; floating enquiry affordance.

photography.quality: strong, authentic destination photography — Taj Mahal, Jaisalmer forts, Varanasi ghats, wildlife (tiger, leopard), yoga/wellness, desert boats
photography.treatment: full-color, warm-toned; often cropped small into cards/tiles rather than shown large
photography.notes: This is the brand's strongest asset and is under-used at thumbnail scale.
